geometry_proposal.use_as: tolerance context only; regenerate from exact current canonical plan, retain all stops, and recalculate service and costs

service_basis: Published Samawah planning seed; no demand, dwell, service, alignment selection or price overrides other than the explicitly fixed per-line propulsion family.
open_assumptions: The route simplification is an unsurveyed geometry experiment, not a surveyed alignment or right-of-way proposal.

All five lines use the same 1000 kg/car powered-axle research mass allowance, 100 kg/car rotating-equivalent allowance, four motors per car and continuous-feed route model; the model does not provide a physically supported available-force map.
The physical vehicle and body candidate identities are held fixed. Route-dependent service, fleet, energy, civil quantities and costs are recalculated.
The demand, occupancy, availability, speed, acceleration, dwell, charging and other service values remain planning-seed assumptions.
Civil classes and prices are Class C modeled estimates, not supplier quotations, route-specific engineering, procurement approval or project-finance approval.
No physical, engineering, manufacturing, operating or movement-authority acceptance is claimed.
